notes.title: 🎊《V-LOVER！》Surpassed 160,000 sales! 🎊
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/b5d80fd717ccd9f1ae1cd938a0712eef388e795b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]From the Lewd Loco × Hentopia team, our heartfelt thanks![/b][/h2]
In just two months,《V-LOVER！》has attracted over 160,000 producers to join this joyful (and lewd?) entertainment adventure!

100,000 was a milestone, but 160,000 is an incredible acceleration—thank you for your support, sharing, and streaming, which have pushed this crazy project even further.


[h2][b]🙏 Apology to players who encountered bugs[/b][/h2]
We are aware that during gameplay, some players encountered issues such as the settings menu being inoperable, as well as other irregular problems that affected the overall experience. For this, we sincerely apologize.
The game has already gone through multiple version updates, fixing most of the reported issues, and has now reached v0.1.09.

Thank you to everyone who shared feedback in the community and discussion boards!

notes.title: 🎉《V-LOVER！》Over 100,000 Units Sold! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/b5d80fd717ccd9f1ae1cd938a0712eef388e795b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]A heartfelt thank you from the Lewd Loco × Hentopia team[/b][/h3]
Thanks to the careful scheduling and stress relief (?) provided by countless managers, we’ve reached a major milestone: over 100,000 copies sold worldwide!
This number is not just a milestone for us, but a true sign that our dream has come to life.
From the initial concept sketches and character designs to every story scene, every live stream interaction, and every gasp and heartbeat.
Thank you all for your continued support, recommendations, and for spreading the word.
Your enthusiasm helped this game, which combines VTuber management, romance simulation, and lewd temptation (ahem), become a global sensation.

[h3][b]🛠️ To the players who encountered bugs, we sincerely apologize[/b][/h3]
We are truly sorry that some players encountered bugs and progression issues during the initial release of the game. We apologize for any inconvenience caused during your first experience.
In the latest version v0.1.06, we’ve fixed most of the known issues, including progression blocks and event trigger problems.
 Additionally, we’ve added a convenient feature in the mid-to-late game to speed up gameplay, and introduced a new “Interactive CG” accessible from the main menu to enrich the overall experience.
Thank you for your patience and feedback. We will continue to improve the game to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience!

notes.title: 《Stranger Maidens Please Protect Me!》Adventure with Stranger Maidens, fight together, and explore intimate connections！😏🔥
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028830/_/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/c816ebbb2c8e7e75915d6a5fa180e6baa28cc1d0.png[/img]

[h1][b]【Game System】[/b][/h1]
Not like your typical Roguelike Survivor, this game focuses on an innovative Squad Based Combat System. Adept to various challenges with a diverse cast of Stranger Maidens, build your ultimate team to eliminate your foes.  

Whether you want to minmax your way to success, or you just want to hangout with your favourite girl, “Stranger Maidens” will provide you with a satisfying experience.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/4d54c5afb7f419c1fe83456b4c2d98925d3694d2.gif[/img]

[h1][b]【Story】[/b][/h1]
You play as Joey, a loser who was traumatised by the loss of his father. One day you received a mysterious artefact left by your father, and you are determined to go on an adventure to find out what happened to him.

In your journey you will encounter a variety of beautiful yet mysterious Strangers Maidens, each with their own story to tell. Combining their combat prowess and the strange power of the artefact, you come closer to the truth with every step…

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/2ec68afb43037392d04cab60e9e06b375197593c.png[/img]

[h1][b]【Feature】[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Tactical Squad Based Combat System provides many possibilities in every battle.
[*] Powerful upgrades await your discovery.
[*] Traditional RPG narration style, you get stories both in and out of combat.
[*] 19 uniquely designed story stages, no more repetitive gameplay.
[*] 6 Stranger Maidens each with their own story and unique charm.
[*] All sex scenes are fully hand drawn and fully animated.
[/list]
